counterfactual_missing_items: personal or family history of rheumatoid arthritis
decisive_items: tenderness over both tibial tuberosities and the right medial humeral epicondyle
synovial thickening with hyperemia in the first, second, third, and fifth MTP joints of the right foot and the first and second MTP joints of the left foot
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it has more diverse support from the raw vignette, including tenderness, synovial thickening, and bilateral arcus corneae, which are all suggestive of Seronegative Spondyloarthritis. R2 is the runner-up because it also has strong support from the ultrasound results, but it lacks the diversity of support seen in R3.

rejected.why: lacks support from the raw vignette and has contradicting information about family history of rheumatoid arthritis
lacks diversity of support and has limited evidence of enthesitis
